apiCall(endpoint,method,data){const url=PROVIDER_URL+'/api/method/'+endpoint;const options={method:method,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}};if(data&&method!=='GET')options.body=JSON.stringify(data);const response=await fetch(url,options);const result=await response.json();return result.message||result}function getCustomerData(){const data=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_DATA);return data?JSON.parse(data):null}function saveCustomerData(data){localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_DATA,JSON.stringify(data));if(data.customer_id)localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_ID,data.customer_id)}function formatDate(dateString){if(!dateString)return'-';const date=new Date(dateString);return date.toLocaleDateString()+' '+date.toLocaleTimeString()}function showToast(message,type){const toast=document.createElement('div');toast.className='toast '+type;toast.innerHTML=''+message;document.body.appendChild(toast);setTimeout(function(){toast.classList.add('show')},10);setTimeout(function(){toast.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(function(){toast.remove()},300)},3000)}function copyToClipboard(elementId){const element=document.getElementById(elementId);if(element&&element.value){navigator.clipboard.writeText(element.value).then(function(){showToast('Copied!','success')})}}document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',async loadSuccessPageInfo(customerId,sessionId,storedData){try{var params='';if(sessionId)params='session_id='+sessionId;else if(customerId)params='customer_id='+customerId;else apiCall('walue_whatsapp_provider.api.setup.get_setup_info?'+params,'GET');if(result.success){document.getElementById('waba-phone').textContent=result.phone_number||'N/A';document.getElementById('waba-id').textContent=result.waba_id||'N/A';document.getElementById('customer-name').textContent=result.customer_name||'N/A';var siteUrl=result.frappe_site_url||(storedData?storedData.frappe_site_url:'')||'';var siteDomain=siteUrl.replace('https://','').replace('http://','').replace(/\/$/,'');document.getElementById('site-domain').textContent=siteDomain||'your-site.com';if(result.setup_token&&!result.setup_token_used){document.getElementById('setup-token').value=result.setup_token;document.getElementById('setup-link').value=result.setup_link||'';document.getElementById('setup-link-btn').href=result.setup_link||'#';document.getElementById('token-expiry').textContent=formatDate(result.setup_token_expiry)}else{document.getElementById('setup-token').value='Token used';document.getElementById('setup-link-btn').style.display='none'}if(siteUrl)document.getElementById('frappe-site-link').href=siteUrl;var
